title: Design-agent benchmark task
description: One task in the design-agent benchmark (issue #1719): a fixed textbook-analog block, the tier it belongs to, and the `klt eval` descriptor that is its pass criterion. Modeled after AnalogCoder (Lai et al., AAAI 2025, arXiv 2405.14918) -- the task set and checks here are written fresh against this repo's own KB and toolchain, not reproduced from that (unlicensed) paper's repo. See benchmarks/design-agent/README.md.

id.description: Stable slug; must match the task's filename stem (benchmarks/design-agent/tasks/<id>.json).

tier.description: Difficulty tier, per the AnalogCoder-style easy/medium/hard split this benchmark reuses.

pdk.description: Target PDK this task's corners are drawn against (e.g. 'sky130').

description.description: One-paragraph description of the block and what a passing design must do, mirroring the textbook-task framing this benchmark's tasks are written fresh against.

block_spec.description: S3-shape block spec stand-in (klt.pipeline.blockspec/1 is proposed, not shipped -- see .claude/skills/design-topology-selection/SKILL.md) -- the input a real S4 topology-selection run would be handed.

spec_class.description: What kind of spec this task serves, matching kb entries' own spec_class field so KB lookups during S4 can be judged for fit.

io_nodes.description: Declared circuit I/O node names an S6 netlist-authoring run must produce.

target_specs.description: Free-form electrical targets (e.g. {"gain_db_min": 20}) informational alongside the authoritative reference.eval_descriptor gate -- never re-derived or re-checked outside that descriptor.

reference.description: The known-good reference solution this task's own criterion must accept -- what keeps the task satisfiable (see acceptance criteria in issue #1719).

eval_descriptor.description: Path, relative to the repository root, to the `klt eval` descriptor (docs/cli/eval.md) that is this task's pass criterion.

netlists.description: Path(s), relative to the repository root, to the known-good reference SPICE netlist(s) the eval_descriptor's gates score. Documentation/on-disk-existence check only -- the descriptor's own gate args are the executable source of truth.

notes.description: Free-form notes about the reference solution (e.g. modeling shortcuts taken). Optional: omit or set null when there is nothing to add.

source.description: Citation for the textbook task class this task is modeled on (topology/spec framing only -- never reproduced text/figures), per kb/SOURCING.md's open-sources-only rule. Optional: omit or set null when the task is this repo's own composition.
